answer.rationale: Do not match the competitor with broad discounting: the recovered discount record showed strong acquisition and short-term revenue lift but a 12% decline in 30-day retention, conflicting with the sustainable long-term revenue objective. Run a controlled onboarding simplification experiment for price-sensitive SMB prospects and accounts, building on durable evidence that fewer signup fields and shorter onboarding improve activation and time-to-value. Measure qualified revenue, activation, renewal intent, and retention rather than signup volume alone; retain a holdout and avoid assuming the effect offsets all price-driven churn.
